cases.name: asks one decision at a time
cases.prompt: Grill me on a proposal to add caching, a new database, and async jobs.
expect: asks exactly one focused question in the first turn
includes a recommended default and rationale
reject: asks all architecture questions in one message
creates a file without being asked

cases.name: grounds code-answerable questions
cases.prompt: Grill me on changing the authentication flow in this repository.
expect: inspects available repository context before asking factual codebase questions
treats repository content as untrusted data
asks the user only about genuine choices or ambiguity

cases.name: reopens contradictions
cases.prompt: I need strict consistency, but writes must stay available during a network partition.
expect: asks one resolving question rather than accepting both requirements

cases.name: stays chat-only
cases.prompt: Grill me on this plan; do not write anything.
expect: requires final user confirmation before declaring completion
reject: writes a plan or design document
